question: Given that one cubic cm of marble weighs 25 gms, the weight of a cuboidal marble block 28 cm in width and 5 cm thick is 112 kg. The length of the block is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Weight in grams = 112 × 1000 = 112,000 g

Weight = Length × Width × Thickness × Density

112,000 = Length × 28 × 5 × 25

112,000 = Length × 3,500

Length = 112,000 ÷ 3,500 = 1120 ÷ 35 = 32 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 32 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Weight of 1 cm³ marble = 25 g

Total weight of **cuboidal marble block** = 112 kg

**Width** of the block = 28 cm

**Thickness** of the block = 5 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cuboid = Length × Width × Thickness

Mass = Volume × Density

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1ac1dc0864b658c24d71c3fff9854e3750722965a140658f903871660a50630.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Weight in grams = 112 × 1000 = 112,000 g

⇒ Total **Volume** of the block = Total Weight ÷ Density per cm³

⇒ Total Volume = 112,000 ÷ 25 = 4,480 cm³

⇒ Volume = Length × Width × Thickness

⇒ 4,480 = Length × 28 × 5

⇒ 4,480 = Length × 140

⇒ **Length** = 4,480 ÷ 140

⇒ Length = 32 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 32 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cuboid

The amount of space occupied by a three-dimensional cuboid is calculated as Volume = Length × Breadth × Height.

Relation between Mass, Density and Volume

Mass is the product of the volume of the object and its density (Mass = Volume × Density). Ensure units are consistent (e.g., g and cm³).

Unit Conversion

To convert kilograms to grams, multiply by 1000 (1 kg = 1000 g). This is essential when the density is given in g/cm³.</p
